**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Licensing and Web Site Hosting Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Mortgage Logic.com. This is our preferred position under NOSOLICIT (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so nothing needs to change.

What I checked:
- Full-text searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "staff" — the only hits are § 7 (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail, an anti-spam provision), § 8(c) (restricting Interface access to approved officers/employees/agents), and § 12 (indemnity references to employees). None is a restrictive covenant on hiring.
- § 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) and § 10 (Confidentiality) — the sections where such covenants are typically buried — contain no personnel restrictions.

One item to flag for follow-up outside this review: § 8(d) cross-references a separate **Non-Competition Agreement** governing use of Credit Data. That agreement is not part of this document and should be reviewed separately to confirm it contains no non-solicit or no-hire terms binding us.
